hotel_name: Raas Vilas By Under My Roof In Gurgaon | Boutique Farm House With 2 Pools For Weddings & Intimate Events

positive_snippets: Raas Vilas was great for our family staycation with necessary amenities and plenty of options for activities. We enjoyed our stay thoroughly. The caretakers, Anjali and Sachin were awesome and took care of all our needs. They accomodated any additional requests as well and the food was delicious. Would totally recommend!

Have stayed here for a big family get together twice in two years time , Wonderful place but needs refurbishing now and newer home appliances ( aircon or even fans , beds and tables ). The rooms are big clean and spacious but Feels the place needs an upgrade and that’s the reason for 4 stars , hope I can make it 5 next time !!

Invest in the place and it should definitely attract more clientele.

Overall service is good , Food prepared is good as well . Sachin and Ganesh are good hosts . A special mention to Shiva who was fantastic at work !!

Also a request - please put a sign outside the dirt road , it’s quite difficult to get to this place and this should help visitors.

I still recommend this place !!

Stellar service and a beautiful property - with just a little maintenance betterment, Raas Vilas would genuinely be flawlessly perfect!
They're accomodating, kind and understanding.
Decor engagements were top notch. The cook, Anjali was a pleasant lady who prepared delectable snacks and a very wholesome meal for us. Sachin, the caretaker was confident and had an approachable demeanor. The property is green, clean, quiet and perfect for a large get together. Definitely worth the visit!
